releases.notes:
MsptMap v1.1.0

### 新增

- **小地图热力图**：同一套区块热力色可以叠加到 Xaero 小地图上（默认关闭，在设置中开启）
- **Minecraft 1.21.10**：新增独立构建（但 1.21.9 从此版本开始不支持，建议玩家升级至 1.21.10 游玩）

### 改进

- 弱加载区块（加载等级 32 及以上）默认显示为浅灰，不再占用热力色；可开启选项，让其中产生过可测耗时的区块仍按热力色显示
- 告警列表与地图使用同一套热力配色
- 降低多数支持版本的 Fabric API 下限，兼容更旧的 Fabric API 构建

### 修复

- 修复 Fabric Loader 0.20.0 与 Xaero 世界地图同时使用时的启动崩溃
- 修复 1.21.9+ 上实体计时读取维度失败的问题（1.21.9 起实体所在维度的方法名变更）

- Fixed a `NoSuchMethodError` crash when scanning on 1.21.9 and 1.21.10 servers

### Improved

- Weak-loaded chunks (load level 32 and above) are now always shown in light grey by default and no longer take part in heat colouring; a new option colours the ones that spent time within the sampling window
- The overview panel folds load sources beyond the first three into a fourth row, and the panel or the expanded list becomes scrollable when taller than the screen
- Alert rows now use the same layout and colour ramp as the overview and hover details; their colour uses the same default red point as the overview TOP5

---

### 修复

- 告警行与总览、悬停详情使用同一套排版与热力色，红点取单区块默认阈值，与总览 TOP5 一致

releases.notes:
### New

- Scan overview panel: totals across the three dimensions, load sources and the five costliest chunks, with click-to-locate on the map
- Optional monitoring (`/msptmap monitor`, off by default): auto-scans on overload and alerts the chosen audience
- Operator commands: `scan`, `access <ops|all>` and `monitor`. Operators only by default; `/msptmap access all` opens it to every player
- Added English localisation, following the game language automatically
- The settings screen is split into scan / colours / hover subpages

### Improved

- Hover details and the overview use tiered styling
- Chunks holding a load ticket are outlined, and the tooltip names the ticket with its `@x,z`

---

### 新增

- 扫描总览面板：三维度合计、加载源与最重五个区块等等，并可点击后在地图自动定位
- 常态化监控（`/msptmap monitor`，默认关）：超载时自动扫描并告警指定受众
- 操作员命令：`scan`、`access <ops|all>` 与 `monitor`。默认仅 OP，`/msptmap access all` 开放给所有玩家
- 新增英语适配，随游戏语言自动切换
- 设置界面拆为扫描 / 颜色 / 悬停三个子页

### 改进

- 悬停详情与总览采用分层配色
- 持有加载票的区块描边，提示中给出票据名与 `@x,z`
- 计时类别更加丰富，计时更加精准，计时开销更小

releases.notes:
**Changes**
- Fixed the chunk details not showing on hover when other mods such as Xaero Head Tracker are installed
- Fixed the console scan getting stuck when the server pauses while empty (no players online)
- Fixed a client crash on scan data of an unexpected size; it now reports a failure instead
- The scan progress ring now fills up to 100%
- Scans now have a 2-second cooldown between runs
- Hover details now use the same number format on every system
- Compatibility: unsupported mod versions no longer crash the game on startup; optional dependencies fall back gracefully
- Various performance and stability improvements: faster scanning, cached hover details, less per-frame work
- Documentation, code and repository cleanup

---

**改动**
- 修复与 Xaero Head Tracker 等其他模组同装时，鼠标悬停区块看不到详情的问题
- 修复服务器长时间无人、自动暂停后，控制台扫描一直卡住的问题
- 修复扫描数据大小异常时客户端崩溃的问题，现改为提示失败
- 扫描进度环现在会填满 100%
- 两次扫描之间新增 2 秒冷却
- 悬停详情的数字格式在所有系统上保持一致
- 兼容性：不支持的模组版本不再导致启动崩溃；缺少可选依赖时自动降级
- 若干性能与稳定性优化：扫描更快、悬停详情缓存、每帧开销更低
- 文档、代码与仓库整理
